state.product: MenteViva, an iOS brain-training app for older adults 60+. All 4 games are 100% deterministic and fully playable offline. Jev (a small fast cloud judgment model, <1s latency, ~50-100 output tokens per call) is used only as seasoning: it ranks the daily game mix and nudges per-game difficulty.
state.current_architecture: One Jev request per local day (4 Noul + 4 Score questions, one state object of anonymized aggregates), fired lazily on first appearance of the game list, cached in UserDefaults for the day. Any failure degrades silently to a deterministic rotation + 3-strikes difficulty rule. The app never blocks on network.
state.audience_context: Players are seniors, many in care facilities or homes with poor/restricted wifi. Difficulty that shifts mid-day feels erratic to older adults. Per-session calls would multiply API cost 4-6x and move difficulty within a single day.
state.constraints: Solo developer, offline-first is a hard requirement (App Store review also requires no forced login for core function). API key must stay behind a tiny proxy.
state.alternative: Per-session Jev calls: re-rank and re-judge difficulty after every play session instead of once daily.

offline_first_daily_right.instructions: Is offline-first with once-daily Jev ranking the right architecture for this audience's context (senior facilities, poor wifi)?

criteria.true: Yes: the audience's connectivity reality and need for stability make once-daily ranking with deterministic offline fallback the right design
criteria.false: No: this architecture sacrifices too much adaptivity; the audience context does not justify it

per_session_worth_it.instructions: Would per-session Jev calls meaningfully improve outcomes enough to justify the 4-6x cost and mid-day difficulty shifts?

criteria.true: Yes: session-level adaptivity would produce meaningfully better engagement or training outcomes, worth the cost and mid-day difficulty movement
criteria.false: No: once-daily granularity captures nearly all the benefit; per-session calls add cost and erratic feel without meaningful outcome gains
